scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @chronopic/desktop build
scripts.e2e: pnpm run e2e:prepare && pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:accessibility: pnpm run e2e:prepare && pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:backup: pnpm run e2e:prepare && pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts backup.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:packaged: pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts packaged.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:runtime: pnpm run e2e:prepare && pnpm exec playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts runtime.spec.ts
scripts.package:smoke: pnpm run package:verify && pnpm run e2e:packaged
scripts.test: pnpm run native:node && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:packages && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @chronopic/desktop typecheck
